# teams_shifts_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing ShiftsPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `access_grace_period_minutes` (Number) Maps to the -AccessGracePeriodMinutes parameter.
- `access_type` (String) Maps to the -AccessType parameter.
- `enable_schedule_owner_permissions` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableScheduleOwnerPermissions parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `shift_notice_frequency` (String) Maps to the -ShiftNoticeFrequency parameter.
- `shift_notice_message_custom` (String) Maps to the -ShiftNoticeMessageCustom parameter.
- `shift_notice_message_type` (String) Maps to the -ShiftNoticeMessageType parameter.
